title: fix(auth): a cloud-managed runtime's password refusal is shown in the session's language
body:
Fixes #34171

Clause-②: yes (widening) — `@object-ui/auth` `ForgotPasswordFormProps` gains the optional `errorMessages`; `@object-ui/i18n` gains `auth.login.errors.managedPasswordSignIn` and `auth.login.errors.managedPasswordReset` in every locale
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：托管环境里有人用密码登录、找回、重置或设置密码时，页面不再显示英文的“请求失败 409”，而是用当前语言说明本环境通过身份提供方登录，并指向那个登录按钮；自建部署的登录不变，只有单点登录专用模式下找回或设置密码被拒时也改为同一句本地化说明。
- 为什么做：属于托管环境登录体验收尾，替托管环境的用户解决“中文页面冒出看不懂的英文报错”。
- 出错会怎样：最坏是这几个页面在托管环境回到原来的英文状态行，其他报错照旧显示服务端原文；改动可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

On `origin/main`, a cloud-managed runtime refuses the password doors with 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, and the code never reached the pages. The hosted relay (`auth-proxy-plugin.ts`, every password door) and plugin-auth's set-initial-password route (`cloudManagedRefusal`) answer in the ADR-0112 envelope, `{ success: false, error: { code, message } }`. better-fetch spreads that body, so its code and message arrive nested under `error.error`, and `toAuthError` read only the top level. plugin-auth's reset doors throw better-auth's `APIError` from the before hook, a flat body with the code. There the code was dropped by the call site: `forgotPassword` and `resetPassword` threw a bare `new Error(message)`. So sign-in, forgot, reset and set-password showed the server's English sentence or `Auth request failed with status 409`, whatever the language, and no host map could localize a code that never arrived. The fix is on the producer side of the client boundary first, then the localized copy.

- `ui/packages/auth/src/createAuthClient.ts`, the `toAuthError` hunk: `code`, `message`, `details` and `userMessage` are read from the flat body first and from the envelope's `error` only when the flat body has none. A better-auth refusal answers exactly as before. The same file already reads both shapes in `acceptInvitationOneStep` (`body.code ?? body.error.code`). `forgotPassword`, `resetPassword` and `setInitialPassword` now throw through `toAuthError`, so they keep the code and status. Their message fallbacks are unchanged. The `updateUser` hunk and `types.ts` (open PR #37433) are untouched, and the two PRs merge in either order.
- `ui/packages/auth`: `ForgotPasswordForm` gains `errorMessages`, the same code-to-text map `LoginForm` takes. The lookup `LoginForm` used is moved, unchanged, to `refusal-text.ts` and shared.
- `ui/packages/app-shell`: `signInRefusalMessages` maps `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` to `auth.login.errors.managedPasswordSignIn`, which says the deployment signs you in through its identity provider and points at the button above. The new exported `passwordDoorRefusalMessages` maps it to `auth.login.errors.managedPasswordReset` for the forgot, reset and set-password doors. Three plugin-auth producers answer that code there, and the map's comment names them: `cloud-managed.ts`, and two that a self-hosted deployment answers too. `sso-only-local-password.ts` refuses an account the identity provider provisions while SSO-only mode is on, and `pending-sso-marker.ts` refuses a pending SSO person. The sentence (you sign in through the identity provider, and no password is set or reset here) is true for all three readers, so the mapping stands for them. It is kept separate on purpose, because the sign-in map's two-factor sentences (`INVALID_CODE`, and so on) would be wrong on a reset door. The package's forgot-password page passes it.
- `ui/apps/console`: the forgot-password page passes the map, and the reset-password and set-password pages map the toast's description through it.
- `ui/packages/i18n`: two keys in every locale (the key-parity test requires all eleven). The zh-Hant entries come from `gen:zh-hant`.

Read first (by risk):
1. `ui/packages/auth/src/createAuthClient.ts`, the `toAuthError` hunk: the read order (flat first, envelope second) is what keeps every better-auth refusal unchanged.
2. `ui/packages/auth/src/createAuthClient.ts`, the `setInitialPassword` hunk: it now throws through `toAuthError` with its old status-line fallback, so it also carries `code` and `status`.
3. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/auth/signInRefusalMessages.ts`: the two maps and why they are separate.

## Tests

- New `ui/packages/auth/src/__tests__/managedRefusalEnvelope-34171.test.ts`. It drives the real client over a mocked `fetch`. Each of the four doors rejects with code `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, status 409 and the envelope's message, and `details` and `userMessage` survive. Three controls: the flat better-auth body answers as before, the flat body wins when both name a code, and an empty body keeps the status line with no code.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/auth/__tests__/loginRefusalCodes-11058.test.tsx`, new top-level describe. It renders the published login page over a real client in zh. The envelope 409 shows the zh `managedPasswordSignIn`, and neither the server sentence nor the status line appears. CONTROL: another code in the envelope shows its own server message.
- New `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/auth/__tests__/passwordDoorRefusal-34171.test.tsx`. The forgot-password page, end to end in zh, shows the localized reset sentence. CONTROL: an unmapped refusal keeps its message. A map-shape pin checks that the reset map carries no sign-in sentence.
- `ui/packages/auth/src/__tests__/forgot-password-success-message.test.tsx`, new describe: `ForgotPasswordForm` maps by code. Two controls: an unmapped code, and no map at all.
- New `ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/__tests__/passwordDoorRefusal-34171.test.tsx`: the reset-password and set-password pages show the localized sentence. CONTROL: another code keeps its server message. A further describe pins the self-hosted SSO-only refusal (plugin-auth's own `SSO_ONLY_REFUSAL_MESSAGES` text) on both pages: it shows the same mapped sentence.

Reverse validation (one-off, no test file kept): `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced the envelope read with an empty object (anchor 1 to 0, blob d7821627 to f40658a6). The envelope pins and the app-shell end-to-end pins went red: `Tests 8 failed | 18 passed (26)`. Restored: blob equals HEAD (d7821627) and `git diff HEAD` is empty. These tests import from source, so no `dist/` was in the path.

## Acceptance notes

- On the sign-in door only a cloud-managed runtime answers `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, so a self-hosted sign-in is unchanged. On the reset and set-password doors, a self-hosted deployment in SSO-only mode, or a pending SSO person, now sees the localized sentence in place of plugin-auth's English one. That is deliberate (contract review 7219466980, S2): the sentence is true for that reader.
- The phone reset doors (`postPhoneNumberEndpoint`) still read only the flat body. The hosted relay notes that the phone-number plugin is not mounted on a hosted runtime, so no managed refusal reaches them. Left as is.
- The set-password page's copy is the reset sentence ("no password is set or reset here"), which fits a signed-in person who came in through single sign-on.
- The claim was revised in 7218058235 to cover `createAuthClient.ts` (`toAuthError` hunk), app-shell, i18n and the console pages. Routing `forgotPassword`, `resetPassword` and `setInitialPassword` through `toAuthError` is three call-site lines outside that hunk. They are needed for the reset doors to carry the code, and they do not touch the `updateUser` hunk.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/auth/__tests__/loginRefusalCodes-11058.test.tsx`. Expect all tests green, including `a cloud-managed password refusal is localized`.

<details><summary>Rework round (head e28f6454)</summary>

- Changes: the declaration is now `Clause-②: yes (widening)` (S1). The changeset and this body correct the self-hosted claim and the mechanism sentence (S2, N3). The `passwordDoorRefusalMessages` comment names the three producers. A new SSO-only pin was added. No runtime code changed.
- `vitest run` of the five touched test files: `Test Files 4 passed`, `Tests 41 passed`. The console file then failed to load until `@objectstack/client` was built. After that build, the console file alone: `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 6 passed (6)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.

</details>

<details><summary>Package tests, type-check and build (head fe59df0b)</summary>

- Closure build: `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' --filter '@object-ui/console^...' build`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter @object-ui/auth --filter @object-ui/i18n --filter @object-ui/app-shell --filter @object-ui/console type-check`, `VERDICT command-exit 0` (auth, i18n and app-shell include their test tsconfig; console includes `src`).
- `vitest run packages/auth/ packages/i18n/ packages/app-shell/src/console/auth/`: the first run was red only on `zh-hant-generated` (zh-Hant was hand-written), fixed by regenerating. Then `packages/i18n/`: `Test Files 107 passed (107)`, `Tests 1867 passed | 13 skipped`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console test`: `Test Files 339 passed (339)`, `Tests 3711 passed (3711)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- app-shell (2428 test files) was narrowed locally to `src/console/auth/`. The full suite is CI's.

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gate families (dispatch-gates --commands, 42)</summary>

- 41 of 42 exited 0. `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` was SIGKILLed for memory on its first run, while the console suite ran beside it. Rerun alone, it exited 0: `Test Files 172 passed | 2 skipped (174)`.
- `dispatch-gates --ran`: `42 derived, 42 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`.

</details>
